'''Free Speech & Sedition''' is a legal-reference surface of the [[SoapBox]] civic ecosystem, published at free-speech.soapbox.community. It sets out the U.S. First Amendment law of speech alongside the law of sedition — the point where protected dissent and criminal conduct are drawn apart.

== What it covers ==
* '''The incitement test''' — the modern standard under which advocacy becomes punishable only when it is directed to and likely to produce imminent lawless action.
* '''Protected vs. unprotected speech''' — the categories the law treats differently.
* '''Seditious conspiracy''' — the sedition statutes and what they require.
* '''Surveillance and chilling effects''' — how monitoring can suppress lawful speech.

== Editorial rule ==
The surface is cited and descriptive, ''not advocacy'': it states what the law is and what the leading cases hold, and is not legal advice.
